{{Quote|You arrived with Malak - your servant - three of your galactic standard years ago. We saw your ship plummet to the earth, a victim of the disruptor field that guards this planet. You and Malak both survived the crash, though you were stranded here on our world. [...] We helped you enter the Temple of the Ancients.|An [[Elders (Rakatan)|Elder]] councillor, to [[Revan/Legends|Revan]]|<ref name="KotOR" />}}
The '''Mission to Rakata Prime''' was an operation undertaken by [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Darth Malak|Malak]]. After their ship crashed on the [[Lehon/Legends|then unknown planet]], they were taken captive by the [[Black Rakata|natives]].

When they finally managed to get their captors to understand what they were saying, they didn't know what Revan was looking for and told him to ask [[Elders (Rakatan)|the other tribe]]. After Revan and Malak found the camp and listened to the concerns of the Elder tribe they discovered how the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] had lost their use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Revan also learnt that the Rakata had built the Star Forge. Revan lied to them calling himself a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the natives then told him how enter the [[Temple of the Ancients]] but that he and Malak were not free to go until they had helped the Rakata restore their use of the Force.

The Rakata continued [[Rakatan Civil War|their civil war]] and Lehon was unknown to Republic once more during the rest of the [[Jedi Civil War]] until the concluding battle of the war.
